scope: Anonymous NTLM renewal of an existing unexpired session retains the security context and keys without extending authority. Full SMB/NFS remains unfinished.

expired: anonymous authentication cannot revive invalidated authority; failed renewal releases exclusive opens
revoked: anonymous authentication cannot revive invalidated authority; failed renewal releases exclusive opens
missing anonymous flag: malformed anonymous token cannot renew a session
nonzero LM response: malformed anonymous token cannot renew a session
nonempty NT response: malformed anonymous token cannot renew a session
anonymous authentication without an established security context grants no standalone file authority
unsigned anonymous renewal cannot enter an authenticated session
SMB2.1/3.0/3.0.2/3.1.1 repeated signed/encrypted NTLM renewal preserves session ID, keys, opens and byte-range locks
expired authority reports NETWORK_SESSION_EXPIRED and renews the same open after an intervening management login
wrong proof and different-user renewal fail, release exclusive handles and complete signed/encrypted watches with NOTIFY_CLEANUP
fresh valid credentials cannot renew a revoked token or resurrect its exclusive open
LOGOFF during an incomplete renewal resets authentication state and permits a fresh encrypted session on the same transport
SESSION_SETUP for an unknown session does not abort another session's in-progress renewal or borrow its signing key
OPEN advertises MAY_NOTIFY_LOCK; READW conflict release delivers exact handle/owner/referring request; the hint neither grants nor reserves the lock
nonblocking LOCK denial does not enroll a waiter and cancels a previous blocking request for the same owner/file
closing the waiting OPEN removes its unsent notification without granting lock state
fresh write-policy authority is required before dispatch; revocation drops the waiter and restoring rights does not resurrect it
inconsistent operation status and lost notification reply cause disconnect then exact two-operation replay; RETRY_UNCACHED_REP consumes the slot without granting a lock
multiple waiting owners share one bounded callback slot and no second notification is sent before the first completes
client NOTSUPP completes the optional callback; foreground polling and explicit lock acquisition remain usable
two-operation callbacks respect negotiated operation and full RPC size limits; constrained clients can still poll for locks
expired client and OPEN state remove the queued hint; releasing the competing lock never notifies or revives the expired session

limitations: Original reauth4 fails at SET_INFO with INVALID_NETWORK_RESPONSE; later operations not verified.
Original reauth5 fails at unlink of a nonexistent destination with OBJECT_NAME_NOT_FOUND; later operations not verified.
Standalone anonymous file authority remains disabled; revoked or expired authority cannot be revived with anonymous credentials.
Windows NFS OPEN INVAL root cause remains unknown; this change adds original domain-error logging, not a speculative timeout fix.
Cross-platform acceptance of the new implementation is pending.
diagnostic_note: A local transparent proxy printed only NTLM flags and security-buffer lengths. Samba anonymous AUTHENTICATE used flags 0x62008a15 with LM/NT/domain/user/workstation/key lengths [0,0,0,0,0,16], leading to support for the permitted omitted LM response. No tokens, password, proof or keys were logged. Service snapshots/server log are omitted from the condensed report; sha256 identifies the full original local report.
